engineDivergence.engineDivergence: Two rendering engines carry the anatomy: modern and rustic. The modern skin is the only file in this cohort that writes its part selectors with DOUBLE-quoted [data-part="..."]; every other skin uses single quotes. The rustic skin is scoped on .rottay-treeselect__dropdown rather than on a root class, and rustic carries heavy inline geometry (engines/rustic/index.tsx:255-727). 'root', 'chevron', 'leaf-spacer' and 'loading-state' are modern-only stamps, all four styled by the modern skin - note that even the ROOT data-part is modern-only here, so the rustic branch is addressable only through its .rottay-treeselect__dropdown class. 'selected' is stamped by both engines and styled by neither. Conversely 'placeholder' and 'value' are styled by CSS but stamped by no engine in this family's source - they are reachable only if some other owner stamps them. classic wraps antd TreeSelect. The modern engine computes node indentation inline with a literal fallback (engines/modern/index.tsx:329).

reasons.why: el interior del control es el pixel de density: si rhythm tambien lo moviera, compacta+aireado seria contradiccion irresoluble en el mismo padding.
Los campos en reposo van planos; la elevacion de estado (focus) es ruido: el foco ya lo dice focus.ring.

Un campo con glass o gradiente pierde affordance de escritura; el input es mate siempre. Opacidades/texturas/filtros leidos y NO cubiertos (state-affordance o efecto gobernado por effect-intensity): --ds-disabled-opacity
Ningun control fuera de la sidebar lee tono de navegacion; dentro de la sidebar usan las hojas text/item-*.
Ningun componente lee el perfil de experiencia: un Button no sabe en que experiencia vive. Si lo sabe, la cascada murio en la raiz mas alta.

Ningun control en flujo tiene z propio; un z-index en un input esconde un problema de capas. Canales z leidos y NO cubiertos por adjudicacion --ds-z-* (dos ortografias de una decision; correccion, no gusto): --ds-tree-select-dropdown-z
